calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS dist_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'
), d AS (
  SELECT store_key, product_key, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT closing_units) du, count(DISTINCT closing_value) dv, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2
  FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT count(*) dup_keys, count(DISTINCT store_key) stores, sum(CASE WHEN du>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) differing_units, sum(CASE WHEN dv>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) differing_val, min(l1), max(l2), min(n), max(n) FROM d

WITH stock AS (
    SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key, week_ending_date ORDER BY etl_loaded_at DESC) = 1
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT cp.category, st.week_ending_date,
           SUM(st.closing_value) AS closing_value, count(DISTINCT cs.store_id) stores, count(*) n
    FROM stock st
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = st.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = st.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND cs.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category, week_ending_date, closing_value, stores, n FROM weekly ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH stock AS (
    SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key, week_ending_date ORDER BY etl_loaded_at DESC) = 1
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT cp.category, st.week_ending_date, SUM(st.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM stock st
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = st.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = st.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND cs.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
